answer_1.quote: In this paper, we propose a novel framework, Learning With Forgetting (LWF), to achieve graceful forgetting in generative language models.
answer_1.outputs: The model generates answers to questions and translates text between languages.

answer_2.quote: We selected four language datasets-German (DE), French (FR), Turkish (TR), and Chinese (ZH)-from the WMT  corpus to evaluate the model's ability to translate from English into those languages. BLEU  and BERTScore-F1  are used as evaluation metrics.
